document.abstract: The problems involved in installing transmitting antennae on tall structures are generally known by those engaged in this rather specialized field. However, when the mounting structure is the tallest building in the world, and of considerable cross-section, the problems become less apparent. This paper deals with both the problems and solutions experienced by a specific station in this particular area of interest.
